name: Kyle Scheepers
contribution: Built CricTrack — a mobile-first app for cricket coaches to track sessions and share progress with clients.
headline: CricTrack — coaching sessions made simple
summary: CricTrack helps cricket coaches manage coaching packages, log session notes, and send clients a read-only share link — no client login required.
body:
I built CricTrack at Cafe Cursor Brisbane to solve a real coaching workflow: track packages and sessions on the go, then give parents and players a simple link to see progress.

Coaches sign in with Firebase Auth, manage kids and session blocks from a mobile-first dashboard, and generate share links that sync from Firestore in real time. Clients open the link and see their current package only — no account needed.

Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, and Stripe for subscriptions.

Live app: https://crictrack-b01a9.web.app/dashboard
